clue.text: Capital head of industry invested in furniture

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, so the top letter of the next word goes into the piece of furniture

parts.note: a sofa is a piece of furniture

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A captain of industry puts money into a furniture business.
explanation.definitionFit: Sofia is the capital city of Bulgaria.

clue.text: Sportsperson penalised for a refusal to exhibit clothing

parts.note: to show is to exhibit
a jumper is a knitted sweater

explanation.surface: An athlete gets punished for declining to model clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: A refusal is when the horse balks at a fence, costing penalties in show jumping.
explanation.definitionFit: Show jumpers incur faults when their horses refuse a fence.

clue.text: Disapproving expression once regularly encountered in offices

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the word

explanation.surface: An old-fashioned tut of disapproval was commonly heard around the workplace.
explanation.definitionFit: Fie is an archaic exclamation of disgust or reproach.

clue.text: Help to make a bag-like structure, say?

indicators.note: say signals that the words are spoken, so we want something that sounds like them

parts.note: a cyst is a sac, a bag-like structure in the body

explanation.surface: Instructions on assisting in the making of a pouch.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: giving aid or support to someone, as an assistant does.

clue.text: Damage source of provisions, coming to old lady's feast

parts.note: to mar is to damage or spoil
a tin of food is a source of provisions
MA is a familiar word for mother, the old lady; with the possessive it gives MAS

explanation.surface: A ruined food supply spoils an elderly woman's celebration meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Martinmas, St Martin's Day on 11 November, is a Christian feast day.

clue.text: Line in great musician's mass producing state of confusion

indicators.note: in means the line letter goes inside the musician

parts.note: a maestro is a great musician
M is the symbol for mass in physics

explanation.surface: A famous composer's mass setting causes chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mass' suggests a musical Mass but is just M.
explanation.definitionFit: A maelstrom is a violent whirlpool, and figuratively a state of turmoil.

clue.text: Copy army expert

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a corps of the British Army
a pro is an expert

explanation.surface: An imitation military specialist.
explanation.definitionFit: A repro is a reproduction, a copy of an original.

clue.text: I worried about stupid person, one making us start

indicators.note: about means going around, so the first pieces surround the others

parts.note: ate can mean worried, as in 'what's eating you'
a nit is a fool
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone frets over an idiot who keeps startling them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making us' is a link: the wordplay makes the verb meaning start.
explanation.definitionFit: To initiate something is to begin or set it going.

clue.text: Abigail, for one, diverts a man when working

indicators.note: when working means set in motion, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman named Abigail sidetracks a man on the job.
explanation.walkthrough: An abigail is a lady's maid, from a waiting-gentlewoman in a 17th-century play.
explanation.definitionFit: Abigail is an old term for a lady's maid, a female servant.

clue.text: Not everyone's problem, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it signals that a word is heard rather than read

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem

explanation.surface: It sounds like not everybody has a difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: Some means a part but not all of a group of people.

clue.text: Fail to heed wake-up call past PM's making comeback!

parts.note: over can mean past or finished

indicators.note: making a comeback is read as going back, so the word is written backwards

parts.note: Sir Robert Peel was a British Prime Minister; with the possessive it gives PEELS

explanation.surface: A former prime minister misses his alarm call just as he attempts a political comeback.
explanation.definitionFit: To oversleep is to sleep through the time one meant to wake, ignoring the alarm.

clue.text: Man disturbed by girl's mode of expression

indicators.note: being disturbed by something is having it break in, so one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: IOM is the abbreviation for the Isle of Man
Di is a short girl's name

explanation.surface: A man is unsettled by the way a young woman talks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' looks like a person but is the Isle of Man, a British Crown dependency, abbreviated IOM.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom is a characteristic phrase or manner of expression in a language.

clue.text: Proper appeal for help by politicians making book

parts.note: just can mean proper or fitting
SOS is the distress signal asking for help
Tories are members of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A fitting plea for assistance from Conservative MPs results in a publication.
explanation.definitionFit: Just So Stories is a children's book by Rudyard Kipling.

clue.text: His act is killing, prompting mirth in southern monarch!

indicators.note: in means the mirth goes inside the other pieces

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the queen
laughter is mirth

explanation.surface: A comedian's routine slays the audience, making the queen laugh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'killing' suggests a hilarious act, but the definition is literal.
explanation.definitionFit: A slaughterer's work is the killing of animals.

clue.text: Dog is aware miner collapsed

indicators.note: collapsed means broken down, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dog senses that a miner has fallen down.
explanation.definitionFit: The Weimaraner is a German breed of grey hunting dog.

clue.text: Average bloke swallowing hallucinatory drug

indicators.note: swallowing is taking something down inside, so the drug goes within the bloke

parts.note: a bloke is a man
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: An ordinary chap takes a mind-altering pill.
explanation.definitionFit: The mean is the arithmetic average of a set of values.

clue.text: Extremely minor graduate reinvented as specialist in theatre

indicators.note: something reinvented is made over in a new form, so these letters are rearranged
the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A small-time graduate retrains as a stage professional.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' takes M and R from 'minor'; 'reinvented' shuffles MR plus GRADUATE.
explanation.definitionFit: A dramaturge is a literary adviser to a theatre company, an expert in drama.

clue.text: Moderate Russian fellows silence revolution in Kiev

parts.note: fellows are men
sh is a call for silence

indicators.note: revolution means turning over, so the city's letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Men hush up an uprising in the Ukrainian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mensheviks were the moderate faction of Russian socialists opposed to the Bolsheviks.

clue.text: Distress a good farm bailiff up north

parts.note: grieve is a Scottish and northern English word for a farm overseer or bailiff

explanation.surface: A good farm manager in the north is upset.
explanation.definitionFit: To aggrieve is to cause someone distress or resentment.

clue.text: Date of military action

definitions.meaning: an appointment or arranged meeting, such as a social date
a battle or fight between armed forces

explanation.surface: A fixture marked for a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: An engagement is both a fixed appointment and a battle between armed forces.

clue.text: Unruffled state identified by millions

parts.note: Cal is an abbreviation for California, a US state
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: A serene American state recognised by millions of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Calm means composed and untroubled, a synonym of unruffled.

clue.text: Series of lectures on this is aimed in the right direction

definitions.meaning: a programme of teaching on a subject

definitions.text: on this is aimed in the right direction
definitions.meaning: something on the right track is said to be on this

explanation.surface: Lectures heading the right way.
explanation.definitionFit: A course is a series of lectures, and being on course means heading the right way.

clue.text: Book of articles on vessel trapped in rock

indicators.note: trapped in means held inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: to totter is to rock unsteadily

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the articles follow the vessel in the across entry

parts.note: an ark is a vessel, as Noah's
A is the indefinite article
THE is the definite article

explanation.surface: A book about grammar is stuck inside a boat caught among stones.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rock' looks like a noun (stone) but is the verb TOTTER.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarka the Otter is a novel by Henry Williamson.

clue.text: A large burden fails to finish a Scottish town

indicators.note: fails to finish means the last letter is removed

parts.note: a load is a burden

explanation.surface: A heavy load doesn't make it all the way to a town in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Alloa is a town in Clackmannanshire, Scotland.

clue.text: Nursemaid a graduate hired to begin with

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts, a graduate

indicators.note: to begin with picks out the first letter

explanation.surface: A graduate was taken on as a nanny at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: An amah is a nursemaid or maid in parts of Asia.

clue.text: Bird hiding among summer leaves

indicators.note: hiding among means the letters are concealed inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A bird conceals itself in the foliage of summer.
explanation.definitionFit: Merle is an old or poetic word for the blackbird.

clue.text: Member of society's real capital gain finally secured

indicators.note: secured means held fast, so the capital city holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: Lima is the capital of Peru
very can mean real or actual, as in 'the very thing'

indicators.note: finally picks out the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A society member's genuine capital gains are finally locked in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' suggests money but is a city, LIMA; 'real' is the old adjective VERY.
explanation.definitionFit: A liveryman is a freeman of one of the City of London's livery companies, a kind of society.

clue.text: Witty remark causing upset to piper's son

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the name reads from bottom up

parts.note: Tom, Tom, the piper's son is a nursery rhyme

explanation.surface: A clever quip offends the son of a bagpiper.
explanation.definitionFit: A mot is a witticism, from French bon mot.

clue.text: On which angels and devils may appear and Lady Godiva did?

definitions.text: On which angels and devils may appear and Lady Godiva did?

parts.words: On which angels and devils may appear and Lady Godiva did?
parts.note: angels and devils 'on' it are bacon-wrapped savouries (oysters, prunes), and the legendary Godiva rode naked through Coventry on it

explanation.walkthrough: Angels on horseback and devils on horseback are British party snacks: oysters or prunes wrapped in bacon.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on horseback means riding a horse, as Godiva did through Coventry.

clue.text: Introduce chips but no fish

indicators.note: but no means without, so the fish is taken away

parts.note: Chips is a traditional nickname for a carpenter
a carp is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: An order of chips without the fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chips but no fish' reads as an order at a chippy, but Chips is a carpenter's nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: To enter something, such as data or a name, is to introduce it into a record.
